releaseNotes: Note Lock Forgot PIN now displays a temporary recovery PIN, then opens the new 4-digit PIN and confirmation fields automatically. No extra OK button is needed. Note Lock Off also completes immediately after the correct PIN. Existing notes, photos, PIN data and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Note Lock → Forgot PIN now uses the same in-app dialog style as Diary Lock throughout, including Copy PIN errors, wrong temporary PIN retry, and new PIN/confirmation errors. No Android WebView address heading is shown. PIN recovery logic and saved notes/photos remain preserved. APK remains 1.0.135.
